blocks.en_text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
blocks.zh_text: 大家好，欢迎来到Real Easy English，

blocks.en_text: the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English
blocks.zh_text: 这档播客用简单的英语进行真实对话

blocks.en_text: to help you learn.
blocks.zh_text: 来帮助你学习。

blocks.en_text: I'm Neil.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Neil。

blocks.en_text: And I'm Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Beth。

blocks.en_text: You can find a video version of this podcast
blocks.zh_text: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这档播客的视频版

blocks.en_text: and a worksheet to help you learn on our website,
blocks.zh_text: 和帮助你学习的学习单，

blocks.en_text: bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 网址是bbclearningenglish.com。

blocks.en_text: How are you today, Beth?
blocks.zh_text: Beth，你今天怎么样？

blocks.en_text: I'm OK, Neil.
blocks.zh_text: 我还行，Neil。

blocks.en_text: I'm a little bit tired. How are you?
blocks.zh_text: 我有点累。你呢？

blocks.en_text: I'm very well.
blocks.zh_text: 我很好。

blocks.en_text: I'm fine. Great.
blocks.zh_text: 我挺好的。太好了。

blocks.en_text: Good, good.
blocks.zh_text: 好，好。

blocks.en_text: Well, today we're going to talk about 'mistakes'.
blocks.zh_text: 那么，今天我们要聊的是“错误”。

blocks.en_text: So hopefully I won't make many mistakes, being tired.
blocks.zh_text: 所以希望我累了也不会犯太多错误。

blocks.en_text: No. 'Mistakes' –
blocks.zh_text: 不会的。“错误”——

blocks.en_text: 'mistakes' can be things that are wrong
blocks.zh_text: “错误”可以指做错的事情，

blocks.en_text: like a mistake in a maths problem.
blocks.zh_text: 比如数学题里的一个错误。

blocks.en_text: But we can also use 'mistake' to talk about really big things in life.
blocks.zh_text: 但我们也可以用“错误”来谈生活中真正重大的事情。

blocks.en_text: Decisions that you've made, actions that you've taken.
blocks.zh_text: 你做过的决定，你采取过的行动。

blocks.en_text: Yes, that's true. So I think let's start the conversation.
blocks.zh_text: 是的，没错。那我觉得咱们开始聊吧。

blocks.en_text: Let's do it. So, Beth, have you made any mistakes recently?
blocks.zh_text: 来吧。那么，Beth，你最近犯过什么错误吗？

blocks.en_text: Yes. So, I recently left my suitcase on a train by mistake.
blocks.zh_text: 有。我最近不小心把手提箱落在火车上了。

blocks.en_text: Oh no!
blocks.zh_text: 哦不！

blocks.en_text: So, I was travelling from home
blocks.zh_text: 当时我从家出发

blocks.en_text: to Leeds on the train.
blocks.zh_text: 坐火车去Leeds。

blocks.en_text: And I got to the station at Leeds,
blocks.zh_text: 我到了Leeds的车站，

blocks.en_text: and there were loads of people, and they were...
blocks.zh_text: 那里人特别多，他们……

blocks.en_text: they were football fans and they were singing really loudly.
blocks.zh_text: 他们是足球球迷，唱得特别大声。

blocks.en_text: And I just wanted to get off the train.
blocks.zh_text: 我就只想赶紧下火车。

blocks.en_text: And that's what I did.
blocks.zh_text: 我就那么做了。

blocks.en_text: And then I realised about half an hour later that I didn't have my suitcase.
blocks.zh_text: 然后大概半小时后我才意识到我没拿手提箱。

blocks.en_text: Oh no!
blocks.zh_text: 哦不！

blocks.en_text: So...
blocks.zh_text: 所以……

blocks.en_text: That's a bad mistake. Did you get it back?
blocks.zh_text: 那是个严重的错误。你拿回来了吗？

blocks.en_text: I did, I was so lucky.
blocks.zh_text: 拿回来了，我太幸运了。

blocks.en_text: The train stopped at Leeds.
blocks.zh_text: 那趟火车停在Leeds。

blocks.en_text: So, when I realised I ran and said to the people on the platform,
blocks.zh_text: 所以我一意识到，就跑过去对站台上的人说，

blocks.en_text: "Arrgh, my suitcase is on the train!"
blocks.zh_text: “啊，我的手提箱在火车上！”

blocks.en_text: And they held the train for me and I ran up the platform.
blocks.zh_text: 他们为我拦住了火车，我沿着站台跑过去。

blocks.en_text: I grabbed my suitcase and then they blew the whistle and the train went.
blocks.zh_text: 我抓起手提箱，然后他们吹了哨，火车就开走了。

blocks.en_text: I was so lucky.
blocks.zh_text: 我太幸运了。

blocks.en_text: But yeah, that was a big mistake.
blocks.zh_text: 不过是啊，那是个大错误。

blocks.en_text: And I will not make that mistake again.
blocks.zh_text: 我不会再犯那个错误了。

blocks.en_text: Everybody says that.
blocks.zh_text: 大家都这么说。

blocks.en_text: So, earlier we said that mistakes can be small things, like my suitcase.
blocks.zh_text: 刚才我们说错误可以指小事，比如我的手提箱。

blocks.en_text: But there are big mistakes that we can make.
blocks.zh_text: 但我们也会犯大错误。

blocks.en_text: So, have you ever made a big mistake, do you think?
blocks.zh_text: 那你有没有犯过什么大错误，你觉得呢？

blocks.en_text: Yeah. Well, once I had a job that I really, really enjoyed.
blocks.zh_text: 有。我曾经有一份我特别特别喜欢的工作。

blocks.en_text: I was teaching at a school in Prague, in the Czech Republic, teaching English,
blocks.zh_text: 我在捷克共和国布拉格的一所学校教书，教英语，

blocks.en_text: and I loved the job and I had loads of really good friends.
blocks.zh_text: 我很喜欢那份工作，也有很多特别好的朋友。

blocks.en_text: But I had this feeling that I needed to go – move somewhere else,
blocks.zh_text: 但我有种感觉，我需要离开——搬到别的地方去，

blocks.en_text: do something else with my life.
blocks.zh_text: 去做点别的事情。

blocks.en_text: And so I resigned.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我就辞职了。

blocks.en_text: But then about a week or so later, I realised
blocks.zh_text: 但大概一周左右之后，我意识到

blocks.en_text: that I really, really didn't want to leave that school.
blocks.zh_text: 我真的真的不想离开那所学校。

blocks.en_text: So, I went back to the boss and I said, "I've changed my mind.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，我回去找老板，说：“我改变主意了。

blocks.en_text: I want to stay."
blocks.zh_text: 我想留下来。”

blocks.en_text: And he said, "Well, it's too late because I've given your job to somebody else."
blocks.zh_text: 他说：“嗯，太晚了，因为我已经把你的工作给别人了。”

blocks.en_text: Oh no! That's so sad.
blocks.zh_text: 哦不！太惨了。

blocks.en_text: So, you left your job,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，你辞了工作，

blocks.en_text: left Prague?
blocks.zh_text: 离开了布拉格？

blocks.en_text: No, actually, a bit like your suitcase, Beth,
blocks.zh_text: 没有，其实，有点像你的行李箱，Beth，

blocks.en_text: it ended up being OK because the person who took my job
blocks.zh_text: 结果还不错，因为接替我工作的人

blocks.en_text: then decided that he didn't want the job either.
blocks.zh_text: 后来也决定他不想要这份工作了。

blocks.en_text: So, in the end, I did stay.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，最后我还是留下来了。

blocks.en_text: So, when we make mistakes, Neil, sometimes we then have a regret
blocks.zh_text: 所以，当我们犯错时，Neil，有时候我们会后悔，

blocks.en_text: or we regret the thing that we did.
blocks.zh_text: 或者我们后悔自己做过的事。

blocks.en_text: That means that we feel bad about it.
blocks.zh_text: 意思是我们对此感到难过。

blocks.en_text: Or we wish that we'd done something differently.
blocks.zh_text: 或者我们希望自己当初做了不一样的选择。

blocks.en_text: Do you have any regrets?
blocks.zh_text: 你有什么后悔的事吗？

blocks.en_text: Yeah. When I was a kid, I guess I was probably 12 or 13.
blocks.zh_text: 有。我小时候，大概十二三岁吧。

blocks.en_text: I had some piano lessons, and I quit as soon as I could.
blocks.zh_text: 我上过一些钢琴课，然后一有机会就放弃了。

blocks.en_text: My parents gave me that choice.
blocks.zh_text: 我父母给了我那个选择。

blocks.en_text: And I regret that because I love music and I play guitar,
blocks.zh_text: 我后悔那件事，因为我喜欢音乐，也弹吉他，

blocks.en_text: and I think I would have enjoyed playing piano.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得我本来会喜欢弹钢琴的。

blocks.en_text: I always think, to be honest, you shouldn't have any regrets,
blocks.zh_text: 说实话，我一直觉得人不该有什么后悔，

blocks.en_text: because whatever you've done, you've learnt something from it.
blocks.zh_text: 因为不管你做了什么，你都从中学到了东西。

blocks.en_text: Even if something bad happened, then you know for next time.
blocks.zh_text: 即使发生了不好的事，那下次你就知道了。

blocks.en_text: And it's a kind of self-improvement thing.
blocks.zh_text: 这是一种自我提升。

blocks.en_text: That is a very positive attitude to mistakes, Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 这真是对待错误非常积极的态度，Beth。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I think it's important to learn from your mistakes.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊，我觉得从错误中学习很重要。

blocks.en_text: And that's a common expression in English – to learn from your mistakes.
blocks.zh_text: 这在英语里是个常用表达——从错误中学习。

blocks.en_text: Let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt in this podcast.
blocks.zh_text: 我们来回顾一下这期播客里学到的词汇。

blocks.en_text: Starting with 'mistake', and a mistake is an action that is wrong.
blocks.zh_text: 从“mistake”开始，mistake 就是一个错误的行为。

blocks.en_text: Or that you do when you don't mean to.
blocks.zh_text: 或者是你无意中做的事。

blocks.en_text: And we can 'make a mistake'.
blocks.zh_text: 我们可以说“make a mistake”。

blocks.en_text: That means we do something wrong.
blocks.zh_text: 意思是我们做错了事。

blocks.en_text: Or we can do something 'by mistake', which means we do something accidentally,
blocks.zh_text: 或者我们可以说“by mistake”，意思是我们不小心做了某事，

blocks.en_text: without meaning to.
blocks.zh_text: 并非有意。

blocks.en_text: For example, I left my suitcase on the train by mistake.
blocks.zh_text: 比如，我不小心把行李箱落在火车上了。

blocks.en_text: We also heard 'regret', which means feel bad
blocks.zh_text: 我们还听到了“regret”，意思是感到难过

blocks.en_text: or sorry about something you've done or a mistake that you've made.
blocks.zh_text: 或者为做过的事、犯过的错表示抱歉。

blocks.en_text: And we heard 'learn from your mistakes', which means remember the mistake
blocks.zh_text: 我们还听到了“learn from your mistakes”，意思是记住这个错误

blocks.en_text: and then not do it again the next time.
blocks.zh_text: 然后下次不要再犯。

blocks.en_text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 这集Real Easy English就到这里。

blocks.en_text: You can test yourself on what you've learned with a worksheet on our website,
blocks.zh_text: 你可以用我们网站上的练习来测试一下学到的东西，

blocks.en_text: bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: bbclearningenglish.com。

blocks.en_text: See you then. Goodbye.
blocks.zh_text: 到时候见。再见。

blocks.en_text: Bye!
blocks.zh_text: 拜拜！
